name: Shera Energy Ltd.
summary: Shera Energy Ltd. operates in the non-ferrous metals and electrical equipment industry, primarily manufacturing winding wires and strips from copper, aluminum, and brass. The company's product portfolio includes paper-covered and enameled aluminum and copper conductors, aluminum and copper bus bars, brass rods and wires, and copper and aluminum tubes. These products are utilized across various applications in the electrical industry, such as transformers, motors, electrical panels, and general electrical appliances. Shera Energy also produces special-grade brass rods for the Indian ammunition industry and is expanding into solar ribbons, conductors, and specialized wires for power and renewable energy sectors. The company serves domestic markets across India and exports its products to over 15 countries, with recent strategic expansion into African markets through its subsidiary, Shera Zambia Ltd., which includes a copper cathode manufacturing plant for backward integration.
